notes: The Blender scene is a rendering and visualization derivative, not manufacturing authority.
Butterfly object transforms are generated from the controlled 240-row engineering schedule.
LED head bodies and Blender light energy are visual placeholders until exact supplier photometry is controlled.
Optical glass, metal micro-roughness, suspension display diameter, sculptural spine proportions and photographic stage lighting are visualization studies only.
Clean product render presets suppress the conceptual 14-head beam contribution without deleting or moving the 14 controlled-position light objects.
CAM_BUTTERFLY_MACRO is a visualization camera aimed at controlled instance VX-001; macro isolation hides unrelated render objects only and never alters VX-001 or its schedule mapping.
The residential, staircase, hospitality and atrium environments are visualization-only architecture around the unchanged fixture and are not site-interface or structural design values.
Architectural environment lighting is photographic visualization lighting and is separate from the 14 controlled-position conceptual fixture lights.
The 0.11.0 lookdev reduces visual-only glass absorption, refines the sculptural butterfly centre and repairs full-elevation framing.
The 0.12.0 environment library adds staircase-void, hospitality-lobby and gallery-atrium contexts using the same authority and scale rules as the residential baseline.
The 0.13.0 final framing pass gives the residential-medium canopy breathing room, recentres the butterfly macro and makes repeated lookdev/finish operations idempotent.
The existing dark studio product stage is the premium studio context; it is not duplicated as a second architectural environment.
Finish variants are render-time visualization overrides only and do not select or qualify a manufacturing finish.
The nominal rotation action is a constant-speed visualization reference derived from the controlled nominal RPM; it excludes acceleration, braking, wind, cable dynamics and butterfly flapping.
Any artistic geometry refinement that departs from controlled geometry must stay inside the Blender visualization domain.
